eips.summary: Cited as the existing BLS keystore (JSON) standard; Manu has not yet started its XMSS counterpart.

moments.context: Kevaundray asked whether Manu would also write the ERC for how stakers store XMSS keys in JSON files, pointing to ERC-2335 as the existing equivalent; Manu said he had not started on it.

eips.title: Hardware and Bandwidth Recommendations
eips.summary: Discussed whether to add a separate aggregator role to EIP-7870 and whether that complexity would push toward PQDC instead.

moments.context: Kevaundray asked whether the group is okay with defining an aggregator role and potentially adding it to 7870, noting it could be opt-in or required for staked entities above some threshold.
Potuz said a separate aggregator role will eventually be needed for quick slots or faster finality but he would prefer to avoid it in the first PQ fork; Kevaundray's closing summary postponed it.

eips.title: In-mempool signature and proof aggregation
eips.summary: Gottfried asked in chat what aggregation infrastructure from EIP-8288 could be reused for PQ aggregation.

moments.context: Gottfried posted in chat asking about EIP-8288's aggregation and what part of its infrastructure could be reused, but the question was not discussed on the call.
